Before you begin.

This diagnostic works best when it sees the real you. Please work on your own, without AI tools, notes, or help from others. There are no grades here and nothing to lose: an answer you guess or get help with can place you in lessons that don't fit, and that costs you time in the classes that follow. Do your best, be honest with yourself, and let the test do its job.
